summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _FileReader and _ReaderContext helpers, _make_file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file beside track(), Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file beside track()); tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests before the script-entry block, plus imports); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 1759). The diff is additive only. Not verified: I did not run tests, mypy, or black, per the instructions. Items to check first: the mock.patch buffering test and the auto_refresh=False tests. Choices made: module open shadows builtin open, so Progress.open uses io.open; _ReaderContext subclasses AbstractContextManager so no return suppression is needed; the Progress.open task is created before the file is opened, per the spec's step order.
